methodology: Owner-occupied baselines for the IMF 2025 top-20 economies by nominal GDP, curated in Data/property-cost-sources.json from the 2026-11-16 merged workbook （前二十大经济体_房产参数与市场动态_合并表）. Static transaction and tax figures primarily follow Global Property Guide (GPG) H2 2026 / 2026-09 releases, with PwC/OECD cross-checks for property tax; China price-to-rent uses China Index Academy 50-city rent-to-price (2026-04); South Korea uses Seoul jeonse-implied yield. Housing prices: UK HPI and US NAR/FRED official medians where available; other countries use GPG sqm × typical size estimates when agencies publish indexes only. Indonesia mortgage seed uses subsidized KPR policy rate 6% (2026-09); Indonesia rent growth is a reference estimate, not BPS official YoY. Market seeds store only rate here; provenance lives in sourcesByField as {name, url?, asOf?}. asOf may be a point date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a period label (e.g. 2026-Q3, 2016-Q2–2026-Q2). Unverified parameters leave name empty. Publish merge for market fields remains live fetch → seed → previous catalog. url is optional provenance for humans and --check-urls, not an Action fetch target. 【v2 · 2026-11-17】数值与 2026-11-16 版完全一致（340 个值逐一对齐合并表，0 差异）；仅修订来源元数据：所有 sourcesByField 条目统一为 name + asOf + 可选 url/note/status（periodLabel 原值并入 asOf，写法不折算）；新增每国 currency（ISO 4217，金额字段均为该币种原值）；GPG 房价同比期次改为按国别实测季；loanYears 不再全球统一套用 EMF；status 取 assumption / not_applicable 时表示该值非观测值。audit 记录核查结论与已知缺口。 【v2 · 2026-11-17】数值与 2026-11-16 版完全一致（340 个值逐一对齐合并表，0 差异）；仅修订来源元数据：所有 sourcesByField 条目统一为 name + asOf + 可选 url/note/status（periodLabel 原值并入 asOf，写法不折算）；新增每国 currency（ISO 4217，金额字段均为该币种原值）；GPG 房价同比期次改为按国别实测季；loanYears 不再全球统一套用 EMF；status 取 assumption / not_applicable 时表示该值非观测值。audit 记录核查结论与已知缺口。
